meta.title: Apply for ACA Health Coverage | Isaac Plans
meta.description: Start your Affordable Care Act health insurance application online — secure, guided, and only a few minutes.
meta.imageAlt: Apply for ACA health coverage with Isaac Plans

hero.title: Get the health coverage your family needs
hero.subtitle: Start your secure application online. It only takes a few minutes and your progress saves automatically.

benefits.title: No cost to you
benefits.desc: Our guidance is free — we're paid by the insurance carrier, not by you.

benefits.title: Subsidies you may qualify for
benefits.desc: Many families qualify for tax credits that lower your monthly premium.

benefits.title: Doctors & prescriptions covered
benefits.desc: We help you find a plan that keeps your current doctors and medications in network.

benefits.title: Bilingual, licensed support
benefits.desc: Get help in English or Spanish from a licensed advisor at every step.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.desc: Sign up securely with your email or Google. It keeps your information private and lets you finish later on any device.

steps.title: Fill out the secure form
steps.desc: Answer a few guided questions about your household. Everything is encrypted and saves automatically as you go.

steps.title: We review and reach out
steps.desc: Once you submit, we review your application and contact you to finalize your plan.

acaApply.secureNote: Your information is encrypted and never shared. This process is 100% secure.
acaApply.ctaNote: You'll sign in first to keep your application private.
